common.taxSettings.intro: Set your default VAT/tax behavior for storefront checkouts and payment links. Dynopay computes and collects tax on your behalf — you remain responsible for remitting it. Per-product and per-link overrides always take precedence over these defaults.
common.taxSettings.applyTaxDesc: When on, tax is added to store checkouts and new payment links by default (based on the buyer's location).
common.taxSettings.inclusiveDesc: Treat your listed prices as tax-inclusive (gross). The tax portion is backed out of the price instead of added on top.
common.taxSettings.countryDesc: Used as the tax jurisdiction fallback and to determine EU cross-border B2B reverse-charge.
common.taxSettings.vatDesc: Shown on receipts. Enables EU reverse-charge validation when your buyers provide their own VAT ID.
common.taxSettings.vatInvalidHint: This doesn't match a known EU/GB VAT format — it will still be saved as entered.
common.crypto.lowestFeeHint: TRC-20 usually has the lowest network fees.
common.crypto.trustNote: Funds go directly to the merchant · amount locked until the timer ends

common.settingsPage.userDisplayCurrencyHint: Overrides your team's display currency just for you. Never affects pricing or exports.
common.settingsPage.taxDesc: Default VAT/tax behavior for checkouts and payment links.
